[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;59756423][b]Why join the EEHP over the THEP? (An address to new and deciding nations)[/b]

The EEHP (Erene Economic and Humanitarian Pact) offers many benefits over the THEP (Thýven-Hydronia Economic Pact), and these include but are not limited to:

- No nation is required to adopt a new currency such as the gilder
- 1% tariff to prevent outside companies getting too big of an advantage over local mom and pop stores (advantage to local economy)
- You are not required to send military or economic aid to anyone (THEP loves fighting in West Shamat)
- Integrated and effective business licenses to attract companies instead of simply allowing them to operate in your country 
- Tourism and travel is visa free, a benefit that the THEP completely ignores. This lets you regulate work visas and immigration while also bolstering your travel and tourism industries
- Technology sharing to benefit the wider world 
- One of the main founders of the THEP is literally in the EEHP (he can see the benefits)[/quote]
They do have similarities, but THEP is also military and invite-only
